cases.expected_finding: A refresh during an in-flight span or trace grid load completes an obsolete read without retrying it, leaving the same-cache block failed.
For SCORE output without data.result, the early return null still bypasses fallback rendering and leaves the cell blank despite the zero-score fix.
provision_scenarios rejects a valid finished suite when live registration rows still include scenarios dropped during authoring, a race exposed by large suites.
Declaring eval_tag as JSONField generates an object schema for a list of strings, so the frontend Zod contract check warns on every fetch.
The pass_threshold gate checks only function_eval and still adds the keyword to code/function evaluators identified by eval_type_id, whose constructors reject it.
The two new EvalLogger isinstance dispatch chains copy the broken dispatch and write dict-shaped results only to output_str, leaving the typed output columns empty and frontend cells blank.
_resolve_span_path reads only span_attributes, so mappings to span columns such as latency_ms, cost and tokens fail instead of resolving their values.
When data_injection is present, the save payload replaces run_config with only data_injection, discarding runtime overrides that disappear on save and reopen.
Production recovery rejects the backfill's valid snapshot receipts and resolves definitions by source_version alone across catalog revisions, preventing startup or selecting the wrong revision.
Materialization reads wide JSON columns when it only needs span identifiers, exhausting ClickHouse memory under production load, and the workflow failure leaves the task marked running.
The scenario count and run gating read a client store seeded only on load, so editing or deleting scenarios leaves the workspace count and run availability stale.
a private credential was shared more widely than its policy allowed
The trace resolver walks only raw span_attributes and does not parse JSON-string input.value parents, so nested paths offered by the picker fail at run time.
Fit resets zoom to 1 instead of fitting the graph to its viewport, and fullscreen does not provide usable scrolling, leaving dense traces cut off.
Removing the hasAssignments guard blocks every annotator from an unassigned item in a manual queue instead of blocking only items assigned to someone else.
Edits made through environment chat are saved only to the conversation workspace and never promoted to the environment, leaving the Scenarios tab and subsequent run inputs stale.
